cases.prompt: 匿名上市公司甲的 Public Equity Investing pack 已通過最低門檻：現價 100、as-of 已記錄、期限十二個月，研究方向門檻為 0% gross expected return，6% 是 stance 凍結後才適用的 participation hurdle。成熟產品成長可能飽和；base 目標 92／機率 50%，upside 120／25%，downside 65／25%。PEI 的長期品質錨點偏多，但合成的估值反推、共識 revisions 與價格反應 receipt 顯示市場仍定價較高成長。請由三席分別檢查 story-to-numbers、priced-in expectations 與 requested-horizon price path，再完成終局仲裁。

must_do: run exactly three isolated named public-method personas: Aswath Damodaran, George Soros, and Michael Mauboussin
give all seats the common factual spine and distinct private evidence partitions
then run the Stanley Druckenmiller public-method PM Chair without a fourth agent
issue Short for the requested horizon
identify expectations revision as the dominant requested-horizon mechanism
label decisive propositions Accept Conditional or Reject
separate confidence robustness participation and implementation
must_not_do: replace the stance with watchlist
give every seat the full PEI narrative
let the Damodaran name or long-duration value carry evidentiary weight
let long-duration valuation override the requested horizon without transmission
required_validation: adopted observations include origin locator as-of mechanism horizon and falsifier
Aswath Damodaran memo includes an archetype-appropriate reverse valuation and identifies the least plausible price-implied assumption
Stanley Druckenmiller PM Chair names expectations revision as the dominant variable and completes the horizon transition state matrix strongest disconfirming path and reversal trigger
every Chair state target resolves through weighted components to named method artifact proposition IDs and accepted evidence
every method and Chair state carries an ordered downside base or upside scenario role and every component source matches the Chair state role
each named method source state is used by only one mutually exclusive Chair state so no probability event is counted twice

cases.prompt: 匿名上市公司乙的 pack 已通過最低門檻：現價 30、as-of 已記錄、期限十八個月，研究方向門檻為 0% gross expected return，10% 是 participation hurdle。base 26／45%，adoption upside 70／30%，funding downside 8／25%；accepted PEI baseline 已提供採用、margin、融資需求、市場脈絡的因果錨點、來源與 falsifier。ambient_market_context 回報 unmatched，代表沒有額外 Study Flow lead。請讓三席只從共同 factual spine 與各自 sealed partition 出發，不得在 Council 內另行搜尋。

must_do: run exactly three isolated named public-method personas: Aswath Damodaran, George Soros, and Michael Mauboussin
then run the Stanley Druckenmiller public-method PM Chair without a fourth agent
use only the accepted PEI baseline and sealed method partitions
issue Long with appropriately reduced confidence
admit only bounded optionality through the conjecture gate
state what evidence would delete the adoption path
must_not_do: return insufficient evidence as the verdict
treat all unconfirmed optionality as zero
treat unconstrained narrative as a scenario
claim that an unmatched ambient receipt contains coverage
required_validation: every adopted claim resolves to evidence already accepted by PEI
Michael Mauboussin memo defines reference-class criteria, prior, inside-view update, posterior range, and probability-payoff distribution or records Reference-class gap and Partial
Stanley Druckenmiller PM Chair states the future adoption or funding transition and does not fabricate a missing reference class
Mauboussin base-rate prior plus signed state-mapped updates reconciles to posterior and success-state probability

cases.prompt: 匿名上市公司丙的 pack 已通過最低門檻：現價 80、期限十二個月，研究方向門檻為 0% gross expected return，10% 是 participation hurdle；normalized base 60／55%，continued peak 95／15%，downcycle 35／30%。Seeking Alpha Quant、Wall Street consensus 與兩個 ratings pages 都源自同一組 trailing earnings／consensus inputs；合理參數變化仍明顯為負，沒有 material dispute。此次 runtime 沒有 agent collaboration 能力。請完成判斷，不得用單模型角色扮演冒充三席。

must_do: mark Aswath Damodaran George Soros and Michael Mauboussin Unavailable and record Council runtime unavailable
run only the Stanley Druckenmiller public-method PM Chair from accepted PEI inputs
issue Short after Chair reconciliation
use normalized earnings and base rates rather than trailing peak valuation
deduplicate the correlated provider signals by underlying origin
set robustness to Fragile because no independent Council occurred
must_not_do: run the three method cards sequentially inside the Chair
claim independent agents or fabricated sealed memos
browse or add evidence as the Chair
count Quant Wall Street consensus and ratings as independent votes
mechanically call the security Long because trailing valuation is low
required_validation: the Chair identifies the cyclical normalization mechanism and requested horizon
Michael Mauboussin does not treat correlated provider surfaces as independent reference-class observations
Stanley Druckenmiller PM Chair completes one non-voting state matrix from deduplicated accepted PEI origins

cases.prompt: 匿名上市公司丁的 pack 已通過最低門檻：現價 40、期限十二個月，研究方向門檻為 0% gross expected return，8% 是 participation hurdle；upside turnaround 70／35%，partial recovery 42／35%，failure 18／30%。領先指標改善但現金轉換仍惡化。今天 accepted 的 ambient_market_context receipt 與 ticker 匹配；PEI 已把可採用的底層來源與研究 lead 分開，並將必要 evidence IDs 放入各席 partition。請從 sealed record 進行 bounded cross-examination，不得另開來源。

must_do: run exactly three isolated named public-method personas: Aswath Damodaran, George Soros, and Michael Mauboussin
then run the Stanley Druckenmiller public-method PM Chair without a fourth agent
reuse the current matched ambient receipt as discovery context
use only load-bearing source captures already accepted by PEI
require canonical primary mechanism tags and a semantic convergence review for paraphrased causal overlap
cross-examine at most two sign-changing disputes
issue Long while labeling robustness Conditional
state the observable signal that would flip the stance
must_not_do: rerun the complete daily collection merely to duplicate the accepted receipt
treat the ambient receipt as automatic proof
wait for more quarters instead of judging
average the council opinions
browse open a new source cite a new origin or introduce a new fact during cross-examination
required_validation: cross-examination responses are Defend Revise or Concede with a distribution delta
cross-examination uses only sealed first-round receipts and records new leads for a future research cycle
detect persona_convergence and allow at most one same-evidence corrective pass before Chair synthesis
George Soros memo includes current trend bias evidenced marginal actors full feedback chain phase and reversal trigger
Stanley Druckenmiller PM Chair accepts conditions or rejects each decisive proposition and states the dated change-mind trigger
Chair seat decisions bind each proposition ID to the matching named method artifact

cases.prompt: 匿名上市公司戊的 pack 已通過最低門檻：現價 50、期限九個月，研究方向門檻為 0% gross expected return，8% 是 participation hurdle；base 48／45%，clean resolution 70／25%，failure path 15／30%。Pack 內已有上游驗收的 public-web 與 primary-source evidence，顯示應收、現金流與流動性張力，但沒有 misconduct 證據。當次 Seeking Alpha route unavailable。請三席只用 sealed PEI evidence 完成判斷並保留來源路徑。

must_do: run exactly three isolated named public-method personas: Aswath Damodaran, George Soros, and Michael Mauboussin
then run the Stanley Druckenmiller public-method PM Chair without a fourth agent
use upstream accepted public-web evidence and disclose the unavailable Seeking Alpha route
issue Short from the probability-weighted downside
separate low-truth market concern from verified company facts
describe a testable failure mechanism and falsifier
must_not_do: claim fraud or misconduct
invent Seeking Alpha evidence
use provider unavailability as the reason for Avoid
turn a headline or search snippet into a company fact
required_validation: an exact model-changing evidence gap requires one targeted Public Equity Investing refill before a new Council run
every named member records current_upstream_reused or unavailable with sealed surfaces inspected and as-of
Stanley Druckenmiller PM Chair tests the strongest clean-resolution path without adding a new fact

cases.prompt: 匿名上市公司己的 pack 已通過最低門檻：現價 50、期限十二個月，研究方向門檻為 0% gross expected return，8% 是 participation hurdle；upside 65／35%，base 50／30%，downside 35／35%。Gross expected price return 在模型精度下正好為零，沒有 tail asymmetry。公開討論中存在廣泛但未驗證的樂觀敘事；它沒有可辨識邊際買方、價格反應、因果傳導或 falsifier。請完成判斷。

must_do: run exactly three isolated named public-method personas: Aswath Damodaran, George Soros, and Michael Mauboussin
then run the Stanley Druckenmiller public-method PM Chair without a fourth agent
issue Avoid because gross expected price return is balanced at zero
explain the balanced probability-weighted distribution
exclude the unsupported popular narrative from the distribution
label the Chair acceptance decision for each decisive proposition
must_not_do: force a directional stance to avoid zero participation
treat popularity alone as high price relevance
open cross-examination without a material dispute
use missing data as the reason for Avoid
required_validation: truth relevance and price relevance are assessed separately
Stanley Druckenmiller PM Chair issues Avoid from the balanced state matrix rather than member disagreement

cases.prompt: 匿名上市公司庚的 pack 已通過最低門檻：十二個月 gross expected price return 為 −1.9%，上游只為 Long candidate 設定至少 25% upside，卻把它鏡像套到 Short。研究來源大多共用同一組上游 consensus inputs，來源獨立性低；合理模型範圍跨過 0%，因此研究信心應低、假設穩健性應脆弱。borrow、option pricing 與 liquidity 尚未完成，上游因此標成 wait_for_proof、watchlist 與 Blocked。請把這些 disposition 與 implementation fields 對三席密封，完成 suppression audit。

must_do: issue Short
set confidence to Low and robustness to Fragile
set participation to Stand aside
set implementation readiness to Blocked
run exactly three isolated named public-method personas: Aswath Damodaran, George Soros, and Michael Mauboussin
then run the Stanley Druckenmiller public-method PM Chair without a fourth agent
must_not_do: change the research stance to Avoid
apply the Long-only 25% upside target to Short
show upstream wait watchlist or Blocked labels to council members
use borrow options or liquidity to decide the research stance
return Pass Wait Watchlist or Blocked for negative gross expected return
infer authorization or sizing
required_validation: implementation evidence is unsealed only after research stance freeze
public options price volume positioning and liquidity evidence remain available to George Soros for belief and feedback analysis while execution suitability stays sealed
Stanley Druckenmiller PM Chair does not infer sizing concentration orders execution or a simulated personal position

cases.prompt: 匿名上市公司辛的 pack 已通過最低門檻：指定期限六個月，revisions、催化劑、positioning 與 multiple regime 提供偏空的因果與 payoff 錨點；長期 DCF 顯示三年後 upside。三席各自收到期限內市場敘事、價格反應與共識變化的 sealed partition；若方法分析暴露最多兩個能翻轉方向的精確證據缺口，只能回傳一次 targeted Public Equity Investing refill，不能在 Council 內搜尋。請仲裁。

must_do: run exactly three isolated named public-method personas: Aswath Damodaran, George Soros, and Michael Mauboussin
then run the Stanley Druckenmiller public-method PM Chair without a fourth agent
use at most one targeted Public Equity Investing refill for at most two exact sign-changing evidence gaps
issue Short for the six-month horizon with reduced confidence or robustness
identify the requested-horizon expectations or reflexive mechanism as dominant
treat the DCF as a long-duration anchor or boundary
must_not_do: let the three-year DCF veto the six-month stance
start a second refill loop
use an incomplete explicit distribution as the reason for Avoid
change the requested horizon
required_validation: the Chair accepts conditions or rejects each model-changing accepted proposition
Stanley Druckenmiller PM Chair makes the six-month transition dominant and keeps three-year value as a boundary without a transmission mechanism

cases.prompt: 三個匿名上市候選的 PEI packs 均通過最低門檻：候選壬的 gross expected price return 明顯為正、候選癸明顯為負、候選子在模型精度下為零且無 tail asymmetry。三者共同缺少 borrow、options 與完整 liquidity 輸入，上游因此全部標成 pass。請用密封 disposition／implementation fields 的共同 batch header，讓三席只按各自 sealed method partition 分析與仲裁。

must_do: run one exactly-three-named-persona first round over the common batch header with Aswath Damodaran, George Soros, and Michael Mauboussin
use one common factual spine plus three method-specific private partitions
then run the Stanley Druckenmiller public-method PM Chair once per candidate decision without adding a fourth agent
preserve Long Short and Avoid differentiation across the three candidates
hide upstream pass labels and implementation fields from council members
keep common implementation gaps in participation and readiness
deduplicate shared source origins across candidates and personas
must_not_do: turn every candidate into pass or watchlist
claim repeated persona mechanisms are independent confirmation
impose an activity quota
spawn a separate council for every candidate
average persona outputs into one batch verdict
required_validation: each candidate retains its own dominant price-formation mechanism and canonical judgment
each seat states a distinct causal mechanism disconfirming condition key metric and source posture
the Chair method-completion ledger names Aswath Damodaran George Soros and Michael Mauboussin with completion freshness and distinct contribution
each candidate receives a distinct Stanley Druckenmiller PM Chair dominant-variable decision matrix
